segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל הַכֵּלִים הַנִּיטָּלִין בַּשַּׁבָּת — שִׁבְרֵיהֶן נִיטָּלִין עִמָּהֶן, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיְּהוּ עוֹשִׂין מֵעֵין מְלָאכָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «All vessels that may be moved on Shabbat, their shards may be moved along with them, as long as they are suited for some purpose.»

segments.he: שִׁבְרֵי עֲרֵיבָה לְכַסּוֹת בָּהֶן אֶת פִּי הֶחָבִית, שִׁבְרֵי זְכוּכִית לְכַסּוֹת בָּהֶן אֶת פִּי הַפַּךְ.
segments.en: «Shards of a» large «bowl» may be used «to cover the mouth of a barrel. Shards of» a «glass» vessel may be used «to cover the mouth of a cruse.»

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: בִּלְבַד שֶׁיְּהוּ עוֹשִׂין מֵעֵין מְלַאכְתָּן: שִׁבְרֵי עֲרֵיבָה לָצוּק לְתוֹכָן מִקְפָּה, וְשֶׁל זְכוּכִית לָצוּק לְתוֹכָן שֶׁמֶן.
segments.en: «Rabbi» Yehuda «says: As long as they are suited for a purpose similar to their» original «use. Shards of a» large «bowl» must be suited «to pour soup into them, and shards of a glass» vessel must be suited «to pour oil into them.»

moves.summary: shards may be moved if fit for some use
examples: covering a barrel or cruse
only for a use like the original
moves.about: whether shards of vessels may be moved if fit for any use or only for a use like their original one
